.. _about:

=====
About
=====

EPRoducer is a set of tools to compute EPR g-values and hyperfine couplings with
ORCA, predict EPR spectra with EasySpin, and compare them with experiments. It
was created and is maintained by Daniel Sucerquia.

EPRoducer started as the :code:`g_values` module of MyUtils, a collection of
tools for molecular simulations by the same author, and became an independent
package. It does not depend on MyUtils.

EPRoducer is distributed under the MIT license.
